comparative_findings.description: GPT-OSS 120B has one fewer grounded failure than GPT-OSS 20B.
GPT-OSS 20B fails GE-019 evidence grounding, while GPT-OSS 120B passes it.
Both models fail GE-010 under the semantic-v2 grounded evaluation.

methodological_notes: The answer_correct metric should not be interpreted independently of the GE-010 evaluator caveat.
Current claim_groundedness is not treated as an independent metric from semantic evidence support.
Trajectory tool-path diagnostics are exploratory and are not authoritative task-failure indicators.

20b.interpretation: The model obtained evidence for the number of degraded/hotspot cells but did not obtain evidence for the total study-cell count required by the benchmark.

120b.interpretation: The model acquired both the study-cell count and degraded-cell count through an acceptable tool path.
